notes.title: Welcome to the Jungle!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]🌿 Dear Gardeners – Welcome to the Jungle![/b][/h2][p]The last few months have been a wild ride, and we’re excited to finally share a sneak peek into what’s been happening behind the scenes of our newest project – [b]Overgrown Cleaner[/b]![/p][p][/p][h3][b]🚧 Development in Full Swing[/b][/h3][p]Our dev team has been working non-stop – writing code, testing mechanics, and polishing every little detail. We’re aiming to deliver a demo that’s not just playable, but genuinely fun and satisfying from the very first moment. The core gameplay loop is at an advanced stage, and we’re now expanding on additional mechanics that will make the game even more engaging and varied.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175110/128f16e1ad280672f6dac54be1abb63d99f2d2fc.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]✂️ Core Gameplay – More Than Just Cleaning[/b][/h3][p]In [i]Overgrown Cleaner[/i], you’ll get your hands dirty (in the best possible way). Expect a mix of mowing, cutting, sweeping, pressure washing – and yes, even [b]spectacular destruction[/b]! We’re blending the best parts of gardening and cleanup sims to create an experience that’ll feel right at home whether you’re into zen garden care or satisfying destruction.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175110/6383723e253cfa381220eb882191457c31388306.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]🗝️ Locations Full of Secrets[/b][/h3][p]Restoring overgrown, abandoned areas brings with it a strong visual reward – but there’s more. Exploring these forgotten places will let you uncover [b]unique items and hidden secrets[/b], tucked away in corners that haven’t seen sunlight in years. Keep your eyes open – you never know what you might find.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175110/345dfc78eee0aff093bd5f0856baf0ff28fd4321.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]🧪 Testing, Testing...[/b][/h3][p]We’ve officially moved into QA testing, and so far, the feedback has been really uplifting! The first impressions from testers included comments like: 'Nice!', 'Wow, I really can see the before & after effect!', 'I found a secret passage!', and 'It was pleasant, I didn’t have any crashes'. Feedback like this motivates us even more and helps us make ongoing improvements - we can keep refining the gameplay and making steady progress. It’s all starting to come together – and we can’t wait to let you try it.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175110/851df76d34ff01516b28627fd2054933f4700260.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]💚 Thanks for being part of this journey from the very beginning. Your support means the world to us – it keeps us going (and growing)! 🌱[/p][p]
➕ Add [i]Overgrown Cleaner[/i] to your wishlist, follow us on Steam, and stay tuned – we’ve got a lot more to show you soon.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Pyramid Games Gardeners Development Team[/b][/p]
